I am old now, 79 years, and my strength is not what it was. This small maize plot behind the house, only a small piece, I manage with help from my children and grandchildren when they come. Here in Mbeya the rains are good, praise God, so maize can grow well even without much. I will put some small fertilizer if I can find the money — urea is what people use here for maize — but not much, and I keep the ash and some manure from the few chickens to put on the soil. Seeds I usually save from last harvest, because buying new seed every year is expensive for a small plot like mine.
